name: BeyondSWE
intro: BeyondSWE 将软件工程智能体评测扩展到知识范围与修改范围更广的任务，包含 246 个 GitHub 仓库中的 500 个实例：CrossRepo 200 题、DomainFix 72 题、DepMigrate 178 题、Doc2Repo 50 题。四类数据分别经过候选漏斗与任务专用专家复核，再共享智能体辅助 Docker 构建、五次稳定性检查和最终质量审计；提交结果在纯净容器中独立验证。
org: Renmin University of China, AweAI Team
build_method: 四类任务候选挖掘、任务专用专家复核、智能体辅助 Docker、五次稳定性验证
metric: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type: 软件工程, 跨仓库修复, 代码迁移, 仓库生成
eval_feature: 跨仓库推理、领域知识、依赖迁移、全仓库生成、纯净容器验证
scale: 500 个实例，246 个仓库（200 CrossRepo、72 DomainFix、178 DepMigrate、50 Doc2Repo）
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2603.03194 Sections 3.1-3.5. The diagram corrects the legacy flow's repository-count/instance-count confusion and records 200 CrossRepo issues across 67 repositories, 72 DomainFix issues across 12 repositories, 178 DepMigrate issues across 120 repositories, and 50 Doc2Repo tasks, totaling 500 unique instances across 246 repositories. It preserves task-specific candidate funnels and expert checks, agent-assisted Docker construction, five-run P2P/F2P or reference-test stability, five senior SWE plus five senior-PhD auditing, fresh-container verification, test restoration and future-history removal, and the distinct issue-family versus Doc2Repo metrics.
intro_en: BeyondSWE expands software-engineering agent evaluation along broader knowledge and resolution scopes with 500 instances from 246 GitHub repositories: 200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, and 50 Doc2Repo. Each family uses a task-specific candidate funnel and expert review before shared agent-assisted Docker construction, five-run stability inspection, and final quality auditing; submissions are independently verified in fresh containers.
build_method_en: Four-Setting Candidate Mining, Task-Specific Expert Review, Agent-Assisted Docker, Five-Run Stability Validation
metric_en: Resolved Rate; Doc2Repo Pass Rate, (Almost) Correct Count
task_type_en: Software Engineering, Cross-repository Fixing, Code Migration, Repository Generation
eval_feature_en: Cross-Repository Reasoning, Domain Knowledge, Dependency Migration, Full-Repository Generation, Fresh-Container Verification
scale_en: 500 instances, 246 repositories (200 CrossRepo, 72 DomainFix, 178 DepMigrate, 50 Doc2Repo)
